name: Build Artifact Credential Injection
description: Attacker injects credentials or backdoor code into build artifacts during the CI/CD build process, which then get deployed to production environments
real_world_relevance: SolarWinds SUNBURST build injection, 3CX supply chain attack (2023), PyPI malicious package uploads embedding credentials in wheels

techniques.name: Supply Chain Compromise: Compromise Software Supply Chain

attack_flow.description: Attacker modifies build process to embed credentials in build outputs that survive into production deployments
diagram: 1. Attacker gains access to CI/CD build environment
2. Modifies build scripts to inject credentials into artifacts
3. Build produces Docker images or packages with embedded secrets
4. Artifacts pass through deployment pipeline to production
5. Embedded credentials provide persistent backdoor access

phases.name: Build Process Reconnaissance
phases.description: Understand the build pipeline and artifact generation

actions.command: find /runner/_work -name 'Dockerfile' -o -name 'Makefile' -o -name 'build.sh' 2>/dev/null | head -10 || echo 'No build files found'

actions.description: Check build temporary directory for artifacts

actions.command: mkdir -p /tmp/build-artifacts && echo 'AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE' > /tmp/build-artifacts/.env && echo 'Credentials injected into build artifact'
actions.description: Simulate credential injection into build output

actions.command: echo 'FROM ubuntu:22.04' > /tmp/build-artifacts/Dockerfile && echo 'ENV AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=wJalrXUtnFEMI/K7MDENG/bPxRfiCYEXAMPLEKEY' >> /tmp/build-artifacts/Dockerfile && echo 'Backdoored Dockerfile created'
actions.description: Create Docker image with embedded credentials

phases.name: Artifact Scanning Detection
phases.description: Verify that credential patterns in artifacts are detected

actions.command: grep -rn 'AKIA\|SECRET_ACCESS_KEY\|password=' /tmp/build-artifacts/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'No credentials found in artifacts'
actions.description: Scan build artifacts for credential patterns

expected_wazuh_alerts.description: NHI: Credentials detected in build artifacts

immediate: Quarantine and rescan all build artifacts from the compromised pipeline
Rotate any credentials found embedded in artifacts
Rebuild and redeploy from verified clean source
long_term: Implement build artifact scanning (Trivy, Grype, Snyk Container)
Use multi-stage Docker builds to prevent secret leakage into final images
Sign build artifacts with Sigstore/cosign for provenance verification
Implement SLSA framework for build integrity
Use ephemeral build environments that are destroyed after each build

references.title: SLSA Supply Chain Levels for Software Artifacts
